Five previously URL-less named selections have verified current museum object pages: Lanfranco NGI.72, Navarrete NGI.1721, Caravaggio Uffizi 4659 and Thyssen St Catherine, and Champaigne Louvre INV1125. Uncropped files are not in the source archive yet.

Additional subject-preserving exact museum identities and multiple-version ambiguity research: Musée de Picardie Gérôme, Mauritshuis 253, KMSKA 314, LACMA M.88.177, Cappuccini Rome Reni original location; van Dyck Lamentation, Bruegel Babel, and Rubens Ignatius explicitly marked as ambiguous and not silently identified by title alone.

Verified KMSKA current Van Dyck attribution of 'Le Coup de Lance' #297 and Prado Ribera Jacob's Dream P001117; two Delacroix chosen subjects are IN SITU murals, not interchangeable with preparatory studies. Flagged original-version ambiguity in Caravaggio David and Jouvenet Lazarus.

Twelve 1747–49 San Polo Giandomenico Tiepolo individual station panels are now referenced via the Commons category's distinct hi-res photography; retain original 1747–49 institution, verify photographer/licence for each image (Station I is CC BY-SA 4.0), no acquired original. Stations XIII/XIV remain original user-selected Prado works, not replaced by San Polo counterparts.
